Ask about an OM

Questions

Can you design just a flyer?

Yes. A single flyer, an offering memorandum, or a full listing package can each be a standalone assignment.

Do we need to book photography too?

No. We can work with your existing photography. If the property needs new images, we can include a shoot in the scope.

Do you prepare the financial analysis?

You or your analyst supply and approve the figures. We organize and design the material; underwriting and pricing remain with your team.

What goes in a typical OM?

An offering summary, property details, location maps, tenancy, financials, assumptions, and broker contacts. The page mix follows your property and the material available.

Can the OM match the property website?

Yes. We design property websites, brochures, and offering memorandums, so the website and the documents can share one design. See property websites.
